phase3_findings.description: Residual, documented fail-open: the gate cannot distinguish a genuine pre-#1462 workpad (never had extension rows) from a modern workpad whose rows were removed/corrupted — both present as a wholly-absent set and both pass Complete. No provenance signal exists at this call site to discriminate. Explicitly documented in the docstring and mirrors the existing absent-AC/Plan tolerance; agent recommends no code change, flagged only so the accepted tradeoff is on record.

Prevention-only comment standard (test-file population): the module-load bypass comment runs ~5 physical lines and is provenance/derivation ('for the same reason as the three verdicts above ... the dedicated #1817 block restores the real function ... re-installs this bypass after') rather than naming a specific wrong change prevented. Trim to the prohibition.

Prevention-only comment standard: the #1817 test block carries extensive derivation/worked-example comments (pluralization rationale, non-vacuous-conjunct narrative, 'Gotcha:' legacy-tolerance narrative, pure-read preamble) that explain why each assertion exists rather than a specific wrong change; the assertion labels already carry the intent.

Prevention-only comment standard (borderline; contract-header specification carve-out shields most of it): the _extension_row_verdict docstring embeds rationale/provenance ('the same fail-open the unticked-AC hard-fail closes ... issue #1462 intended rather than a silent bookkeeping miss') that belongs in the issue/internal docs; the behavioral contract is what the docstring must carry.

AC4 (no-PATCH/exit-code) asserts only (exit=1, patched=None) via the real cmd_update path; its attribution to the extension-row gate depends on the out-of-band fact that the three sibling verdicts are no-op'd at that line. Asserting '[extension-row-unrecorded]' in the error (as AC1 already does on the exception path) would pin the refusal source against future sibling-verdict changes. Resilience nit, not a coverage hole.

No single-body mixed-disposition test (one ticked + one unticked-noted + one unticked-un-noted -> exactly the last is offending). Each disposition is exercised separately and the multi-row count string ('2 prompt-extension row(s)') already closes the satisfied-row-leak concern, so this is a DAMP/readability improvement, not a real coverage gap.

The 'state not established' sentinel is a coupled literal across the phase-file producer guidance (phase-1-setup.md) and the gate detector (workpad.py), with no test pinning them together. Drift direction is safe (a mismatch refuses Complete rather than silently finalizing), so not a correctness defect, but consider a shared constant or a test asserting producer and detector agree.

code-reviewer.assessment: No issues at or above confidence 80. Verified _CHECKBOX_ROW_RE group indices (2=checkbox, 4=text), _EXTENSION_ROWS 3-tuple unpack, note-detection excludes checkbox lines and requires substr + 'state not established', absent-row tolerance, pure-read raising _UpdateError before PATCH (AC4). silent-failure-hunter.assessment: Error handling is fail-closed and correct: structural _UpdateError before any PATCH, no silent swallow/broad except/fallback-to-mock. One informational LOW: inherent, documented fail-open on a rowless workpad; no change recommended.

comment-analyzer.assessment: Comment accuracy clean — no documented falsehoods, no comment drift; changeset and phase-1-setup.md additions truthful against the implementation. Three Suggestions under the prevention-only comment standard (test-file and contract-header populations): over-long/derivation comments in the test block and embedded rationale in the docstring (docstring largely shielded by the specification carve-out).

pr-test-analyzer.assessment: Test coverage comprehensive and well-constructed. Every AC and named edge case exercised (refusal+row-naming, all-ticked/noted finalize, Blocked/Failed, no-PATCH abort, multi-row plural, wrong-row note non-vacuous, legacy absent-row set, pure-read invariant). Test isolation (sibling verdicts no-op'd, real function restored only in the dedicated block) sound. No critical/important gaps; two low-severity hardening suggestions.

requesting-code-review.assessment: Change is correct and faithfully satisfies the specification; verified each AC against the implementation and mutation ordering (note append at line 5961 before the gate at line 6101). Regex group usage, _CHECKBOX_ROW_RE reuse, note-line/checkbox non-collision all sound. One Suggestion: the 'state not established' coupled literal across phase file and gate has no pin (safe drift direction). Ready to proceed.

# PRFlow Review (blinded shadow) — PR #1943 (issue #1817)

**Verdict: APPROVE**

**Reviewed HEAD:** b51f1b4f78461572e0edcf6526d4abc767d54059
**Diff profile:** engine_self_modifying (touches skills/**, lib/**, scripts/**) -> full Phase 1+2 checklist; Phase 3 roster gated by applicability.
**Dispatch mode:** fanned-out.

## Scope
Adds `_extension_row_verdict(progress_content)` to `scripts/workpad.py`, wired into `_terminal_complete_gate` after the three sibling verdicts, refusing `--status Complete` while any `_EXTENSION_ROWS` `prompt extension resolved:` row is unticked and carries no `state not established` note (naming each offending row, tagged `[extension-row-unrecorded]`). Ticked rows, unticked-with-note rows, and a wholly-absent (pre-#1462) row set all pass; Blocked/Failed are unchanged. §1.3 of `skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md` names the gate; a 150-line test block covers `lib/test/test_python_scripts.py`; a changeset is added.

## Phase 0.5 classification
engine_self_modifying=true; has_new_types=false (a function, no new type -> type-design-analyzer gated out); small_diff=false (222 changed lines); config_only=false; detect_all_audit=false (`_EXTENSION_ROWS` is a fixed hand-listed set, not an enumerated population). Roster: 4 always-on + pr-test-analyzer (test file modified). 5/5 expected reviewers dispatched and returned.

## Phase 2
Checklist (VC-1..VC-11) all PASS: `_EXTENSION_ROWS` is a 3-tuple `(phase, text, substr)`; `_CHECKBOX_ROW_RE` group(2)=checkbox, group(4)=text; `[x]`/`[X]` both treated as ticked; note detection excludes checkbox lines and requires the row substr + `state not established`; the four row substrings are pairwise non-containing (no cross-satisfaction); the `--note` append (line 5961) precedes the gate read (line 6101), so a same-call note is visible; the verdict raises before any PATCH. 0 failed, 0 inconclusive.

## Phase 3 findings
No Critical or Important findings. Seven Suggestion-level findings across five reviewers:
- silent-failure-hunter (informational LOW): documented, inherent fail-open on a rowless workpad — cannot distinguish a genuine pre-#1462 workpad from one whose rows were destroyed; no change recommended.
- comment-analyzer x3: prevention-only comment standard — over-long/derivation comments in the test block (module-load bypass, worked-example narratives) and embedded rationale in the docstring (largely shielded by the contract-header specification carve-out).
- pr-test-analyzer x2: AC4 could additionally assert `[extension-row-unrecorded]` to pin the refusal source against future sibling-verdict changes; a single-body mixed-disposition test would improve readability. Both non-blocking; existing tests already fail if the behavior breaks.
- requesting-code-review: the `state not established` sentinel is a coupled literal across the phase file and the gate with no pin (safe drift direction — a mismatch refuses rather than silently finalizes).

## Verdict rationale
The implementation correctly and faithfully satisfies all five acceptance criteria, mirrors the established `_required_artifact_verdict`/`_review_coverage_verdict` verdict-member pattern, is fail-closed (structural `_UpdateError` before any PATCH), and its diff-added prose/comments are truthful against HEAD. All findings are Suggestion-level or informational quality nits; none blocks merge. APPROVE.
